purpose: Render the same predeclared validation seed for the equal-budget W4 and W12 support-priority continuations.
selection_rule: Seed 73802 was declared before formal training as the representative trace seed. Both conditions use the first 45 physical seconds and identical rendering settings.

representative_video.selection_rule: Seed 73802 was declared before formal training as the representative trace seed. Both W4 and W12 use the first 45 physical seconds and identical rendering settings; neither was selected for appearance.

claim_boundary: The videos are qualitative paired evidence. Render decorations and camera motion do not affect dynamics; brief contact-speed exceedance is not by itself proof of sustained sliding.
